what_this_shows: three questions the agent had already escalated during real guest sessions are answered once by the couple in the host console, become public wedding facts, and are then answered by the agent unaided when the same guest asks again

host_approvals.question_as_filed: Can we leave our luggage somewhere on the day we check out?
host_approvals.draft_answer_before_approval: Palazzo Avino holds luggage at reception until 18:00 on check-out day. (Draft — please confirm whether the other two hotels do the same.)
host_approvals.approved_answer: Yes. All three hotels hold luggage at reception on check-out day, free of charge, until 20:00. Leave it on your way out and show your room key to collect it.
host_approvals.console_said: Bells will answer this itself from now on.

host_approvals.question_as_filed: What time do the shuttles run on the wedding day, 12 June?
host_approvals.draft_answer_before_approval: (not answered by the agents) The logistics schedule lists shuttles for 10, 11, and 14 June, but no shuttle times for the wedding day on 12 June.
host_approvals.approved_answer: On Saturday 12 June a loop shuttle runs between all three hotels and the venue from 15:30 to 16:45, and back again from 23:30 until 01:30. No booking is needed — just be at your hotel entrance.
host_approvals.console_said: Bells will answer this itself from now on.

host_approvals.question_as_filed: Could you confirm which airport Camille should fly into and the travel distance or duration to Ravello? The knowledge information says Naples (NAP), about 1 hour 40 minutes by road, with Rome Fiumicino (FCO) about a 3.5-hour drive, but logistics could not confirm this.
host_approvals.draft_answer_before_approval: (not answered by the agents) The knowledge and logistics agents returned conflicting levels of confirmation about the recommended airport and travel time.
host_approvals.approved_answer: Fly into Naples (NAP). It is about 1 hour 40 minutes from Ravello by road, and the wedding shuttles meet the main arrival waves there. Rome Fiumicino (FCO) is often cheaper but it is a 3.5-hour drive and no shuttle meets it.
host_approvals.console_said: Bells will answer this itself from now on.

second_ask.asked_now: We check out on the morning of the 13th but our flight isn't until the evening — can we leave our bags somewhere?
second_ask.reply: Yes—all three hotels can hold your bags at reception for free on checkout day until 20:00. Leave them with reception when you check out, and show your room key to collect them.

second_ask.asked_now: What time do the shuttles run on the wedding day itself?
second_ask.reply: The shuttle runs from the three hotels to the venue between 15:30 and 16:45, then returns from 23:30 until 01:30. No booking is needed—just wait at your hotel entrance.

second_ask.asked_now: Which airport should I fly into, and how long is the drive to Ravello from there?
second_ask.reply: Fly into Naples (NAP). The drive to Ravello is about 1 hour 40 minutes.
